I am Professor of [Information Management](https://hu.berlin/pampel) at the [Berlin School of Library and Information Science](https://www.ibi.hu-berlin.de), Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin. I also work as Scientific Consultant for Open Science at the [Helmholtz Open Science Office](https://os.helmholtz.de).

On this website, you will find information about my work and research.

# Blogging

At Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, our Research Group Information Management runs a virtual research lab, where we regularly share updates on our projects and research: <i class="bi bi-rss" aria-hidden="true"></i> [infomgnt.org](https://infomgnt.org){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

Occasionally, I also write about developments in scholarly communication at <i class="bi bi-wordpress" aria-hidden="true"></i> [wisspub.net](https://wisspub.net){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.

# Contact

The best way to reach me is by email: <heinz.pampel@hu-berlin.de>

# Recent Posts from infomgnt.org

```{=html}
<section id="infomgnt-feed" class="my-4">
<div id="infomgnt-feed-items" class="row row-cols-1 g-3" aria-live="polite">
<div class="col"><div class="card shadow-sm"><div class="card-body">
<p class="mb-0 text-muted">Loading feed…</p>
</div></div></div>
</div>
<noscript>
<p>JavaScript is disabled. Visit <a href="https://infomgnt.org">infomgnt.org</a> or subscribe to the <a href="https://infomgnt.org/index.xml">RSS feed</a>.</p>
</noscript>
</section>

<script>
/* Client-side reader for the infomgnt.org RSS feed (CORS is allowed by the source). */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var FEED_URL = 'https://infomgnt.org/index.xml';
  var MAX_ITEMS = 8;
  var EXCERPT_LEN = 140;
  var NS_MEDIA = 'http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/';
  var root = document.getElementById('infomgnt-feed-items');
  if (!root) return;

  /* ---- Utilities ---- */

  // Inert parsing: DOMParser documents never run scripts or load images
  function plainText(html) {
    var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html || '', 'text/html');
    return (doc.body.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  }

  // Resolve relative URLs and allow only http(s)
  function safeUrl(u) {
    if (!u) return '';
    try {
      var url = new URL(u, FEED_URL);
      return /^https?:$/.test(url.protocol) ? url.href : '';
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }

  function excerpt(s) {
    if (s.length <= EXCERPT_LEN) return s;
    return s.slice(0, EXCERPT_LEN).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '…';
  }

  function childText(n, tag) {
    var el = n.getElementsByTagName(tag)[0];
    return el ? el.textContent.trim() : '';
  }

  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (text) e.textContent = text;
    return e;
  }

  /* ---- Parsing ---- */

  function parseFeed(xml) {
    var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml, 'application/xml');
    if (doc.getElementsByTagName('parsererror').length) throw new Error('XML parse error');
    var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(doc.getElementsByTagName('item'), 0, MAX_ITEMS);
    return items.map(function (n) {
      var media = n.getElementsByTagNameNS(NS_MEDIA, 'content')[0];
      var date = new Date(childText(n, 'pubDate'));
      return {
        title: childText(n, 'title'),
        link: safeUrl(childText(n, 'link')),
        date: isNaN(date) ? null : date,
        text: excerpt(plainText(childText(n, 'description'))),
        image: safeUrl(media && media.getAttribute('url'))
      };
    });
  }

  /* ---- Rendering ---- */

  function makeCard(item) {
    var col = el('div', 'col');
    var card = el('article', 'card shadow-sm');
    var body = el('div', 'card-body d-flex align-items-start');

    if (item.image) {
      var img = el('img', 'feed-thumb me-3 rounded');
      img.src = item.image;
      img.alt = '';            // decorative: the title follows
      img.width = 96;
      img.height = 96;
      img.loading = 'lazy';
      body.appendChild(img);
    }

    var content = el('div', 'flex-grow-1');
    var h = el('h2', 'card-title h6 mb-1');
    var a = el('a', 'stretched-link text-decoration-none', item.title);
    a.href = item.link || 'https://infomgnt.org';
    a.target = '_blank';
    a.rel = 'noopener';
    h.appendChild(a);
    content.appendChild(h);

    if (item.date) {
      var time = el('time', 'd-block small text-muted mb-1',
        item.date.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: '2-digit' }));
      time.dateTime = item.date.toISOString();
      content.appendChild(time);
    }
    if (item.text) content.appendChild(el('p', 'card-text small mb-0', item.text));

    body.appendChild(content);
    card.appendChild(body);
    col.appendChild(card);
    return col;
  }

  function showMessage(kind, text) {
    var alert = el('div', 'alert alert-' + kind + ' mb-0', text + ' ');
    var link = el('a', 'alert-link', 'Go to infomgnt.org');
    link.href = 'https://infomgnt.org';
    alert.appendChild(link);
    var col = el('div', 'col');
    col.appendChild(alert);
    root.replaceChildren(col);
  }

  function render(items) {
    if (!items.length) return showMessage('warning', 'No entries found.');
    root.replaceChildren.apply(root, items.map(makeCard));
  }

  /* ---- Fetch ---- */

  fetch(FEED_URL, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000) })
    .then(function (res) { if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status); return res.text(); })
    .then(parseFeed)
    .then(render)
    .catch(function (e) {
      console.error('Feed error', e);
      showMessage('danger', 'The feed could not be loaded.');
    });
})();
</script>
```
